items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All five ACs of the P2a spec are covered: scratch project (git, bare origin, fake GitHub fetch URL, file push URL), explicit environment with a leak check, gh stub contract with argv log, driver interface and freeze test. AC record unchanged.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: The stub refuses loudly (exit 1/2/3) for unknown commands, missing state, corrupt state and unsupported merge flags; run_scenario raises on an unknown step instead of skipping.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Environment is an allowlist; secret-shaped names and SHIPWRIGHT_ROOT fail the build; GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=file blocks the fake https URL; user git config and hooks are isolated; parent environment untouched.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real spawned stub process, real git, byte-identical traces across two scratches, seeded-difference test (tag on the wrong commit), hostile git config test, freeze cases incl. delta mismatch variants.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Scratch build is about a second; no network; stub merge uses a temp clone of a local bare repo.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Three stdlib testkit modules, all new files under 300 lines (largest 218); tests split across four shared/tests files and the plugin golden folder.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Boundary: env var seam -> spawned stub process -> bare git remote, and trace -> sha256 lock. Probed with the real create_github_release.py script through the stub and by building the trace on two scratches.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No skips added; prerequisites (git) fail rather than skip.
